metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from Agulhas Labs. Delegate: a team of agents sized to the job, and a report of where your tokens went. Cache Guard: a warning before the one message that costs twenty times the rest.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Your Claude Code session leads a team of agents, each on the cheapest model that can do its job. Work isn't accepted until a command proves it, and a built-in report shows where your tokens went.
plugins.displayName: Delegate: Agents Sized to the Job

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Warns once before a message that will cost far more than usual: a large Claude Code context whose prompt cache has expired, or a model or effort change that resets it. Shows the estimated cost, and offers a handoff file written by a cheap model in the background so you can /clear instead. While background work runs, it wakes an idle session just before its cache expires, so the result lands on a warm cache.
